title: Robert Pattinson Makes an Old Fashioned, Michelada, Margarita and More | Vogue
description:
“The Drama” star Robert Pattinson gets behind the bar to pair some of his favorite drinks with some of his biggest films. Watch as the versatile actor mixes up cocktails, pairing a michelada with his blockbuster vampire franchise Twilight, an Old Fashioned with The Batman, and a pickle margarita with The Exorcist.

Director: Jackie Phillips
Director of Photography: Riccardo Mejia
Editors: Lika Kumoi, Evan Allan
Producer: Chase Lewis
Associate Producer: Lea Donenberg
Mixologist: Camron Robertson
